sourceSnapshot: current working tree; local edits may differ from baselineSha

scope.exclusionReason: Application source denominator is src. Storybook infrastructure and public assets are counted separately. Build outputs, docs, automation, backend SQL and standalone animation workspace are outside that denominator.
scope.symlinks: Not followed; dependency trees and linked workspaces excluded.
scope.jsxCounting: One occurrence per opening/self-closing JSX element or fragment. Closing tags are not counted again. Every occurrence has a source line and column. Anonymous JSX callbacks are separate owners.
scope.reactElementCounting: Calls to createElement imported from react, including named aliases and default/namespace property calls. Separate from JSX counts. document.createElement is excluded.

coverageMeaning.documented: Story meta.component resolves to this component (file coverage also uses index componentPath).
coverageMeaning.composed-in-story: An explicit JSX tag in a story resolves to this component/file.
coverageMeaning.dependency-only: A runtime import/re-export path is reachable from a story. It does not prove component or state rendering.
coverageMeaning.no-story-candidate: No static Storybook link was found; not automatically a defect.

limitations: Static inventory is not visual, interaction, responsive, accessibility, permission or live-data verification.

Components are syntax candidates: JSX-bearing functions, anonymous callbacks, createElement/useRender/createPortal functions and aliases/factories. They are not all independent public React components.
Factory components without JSX, local tag use or recognized factory naming can require manual review. Runtime dynamic tag selection and external package internals are not expanded.
Transitive import reachability includes barrels and unused runtime imports. It is deliberately classified dependency-only, never visual coverage.
Controls/args/play fields report declared property names and presence, not semantic correctness or test success. Object spreads and computed metadata need manual review.
MDX files, when present, remain in the denominator with an explicit unsupported-parser diagnostic.
App route/layout and inline fragment contexts require manual state-matrix review; no-story-candidate does not mandate a separate story.
